name: CompuLab Ltd.
summary: CompuLab Ltd. manufactures and sells ARM-based computer-on-module and system-on-module products worldwide. It also offers miniature fanless-PCs for industrial applications; IoT gateways; and single board computers. Its products are embedded in telecommunication systems, automotive devices, gaming systems, medical devices, aerospace and marine systems, and other applications. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Yokneam Illit, Israel.
